uutiset.t: Australia Says Negotiations Continue on Gas Reservation Proposal
uutiset.s: The Australian government says negotiations over its gas reservation proposals are continuing and it hopes the legislation will pass parliament in the coming week.

uutiset.t: Switzerland Prolongs Neutrality Soul-Searching With Weapons Vote
uutiset.s: Switzerland is once again debating its longstanding neutrality, extending a dilemma that’s plagued the country since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

uutiset.t: China’s Top Planner Seeks Faster Construction of State Projects
uutiset.s: China’s top planning agency urged local authorities to speed up the construction of government investment projects and disbursement of funds in a bid to spur growth in the world’s second-largest economy.

uutiset.t: Australian Energy Officials Warned of Data Center Risk, Age Says
uutiset.s: Australian energy authorities warned the government that its plan to attract more data centers to Victoria would present a “major structural challenge” to the southern state’s electricity system, The Age reported, citing official documents.

uutiset.t: China Military Bans SF Express From Procurement Over Misconduct
uutiset.s: SF Express Co., a leading Chinese delivery and logistics company, has been suspended from participating in military-wide procurement of goods, engineering and services over alleged violations.

uutiset.t: Vietnam Amends Laws to Speed Land Clearance, Development of New Projects
uutiset.s: Vietnam’s National Assembly passed land law amendments aimed at speeding up site clearance and unblocking of property and infrastructure projects as the government seeks to achieve its multiyear double-digit economic growth target.

uutiset.t: Peru Rattled by 6.7-Magnitude Quake, With No Casualties Reported
uutiset.s: Peru was shaken by a powerful earthquake late Friday that damaged some houses and disrupted power in a central district.

uutiset.t: J&J Snack Foods CEO on 4Q Results and Consumer Sentiment
uutiset.s: J&J Snack Foods CEO Dan Fachner said the company’s turnaround is on track after a strong year, citing Project Apollo’s more than $25 million in durable savings. uutiset.t: Salvadoran Troops Killed in Haiti Blast Amid Rescue Mission
uutiset.s: Three Salvadoran soldiers died in Haiti after an explosion struck an area where they were working, weeks after President Nayib Bukele ordered a large deployment to the Caribbean island nation to find missing troops.

uutiset.t: Trump Says Huang Should Return to Nvidia After ‘Big Apology’
uutiset.s: President Trump called for Jensen Huang to make a big apology and return as CEO of Nvidia even as the prospect remains highly unlikely. (Source: Bloomberg)
